acceptanceCriteria: cem prepare (and Tasks criterion export) can emit the external form from a declared external repository; cem status and the console accept --external-repository and report the criterion as verified, rejected or not observed; any result-format change goes through a recorded re-emission; tests and spec.
body: Residual from GitHub beamfall/corvint#1332 (PR #1343, V1-2100, CEM-V1-330..337). The external criterion form is verified only by `cem verify --external-repository NAME=/abs/path`. Gaps: cem prepare and Tasks cannot emit it; cem status and the console take no external repositories; there is no per-criterion NOT_OBSERVED result field (deferred because it changes the frozen result format and needs a CEM-V1-091 re-emission); RESULT.schema criterionBinding covers only the Tasks form.
title: External criterion form: no producer emits it and core read paths take no external repositories
